name: Something Else
useWhen: Use this when none of the other types fit, like a note, a message to a group, or a form reply.

sections.label: Greeting
sections.what: A hello to the reader. Skip it if this piece doesn't need one.
sections.tip: Use their name if you know it.

sections.label: Purpose
sections.what: Why you are writing, in one or two sentences.
sections.good: I'm writing to let the team know the break room will close on Monday, Nov 2.
phrases: I'd like to let you know…

sections.label: Details
sections.tip: Give real dates, times, places, and numbers. One idea per sentence.
sections.good: It will reopen on Friday, Nov 6. The second-floor kitchen stays open.
sections.bad: It'll be closed for a while.

sections.label: Ask
sections.what: What you want the reader to do next.
sections.tip: Ask for one clear action with a real date.
sections.good: Please take your food out of the fridge by Friday, Oct 30.
